description: This file implements a protocol for cross-tool communication in a debugging or profiling environment. It defines the CrossToolProtocol class that handles message exchange via window.postMessage, including bug report and timestamp messages, and manages allowed origins for security.

classes.name: RemoteTool
classes.description: Helper class representing a remote tool with associated window and origin.

classes.name: CrossToolProtocol
classes.description: Main class implementing communication protocol for handling messages related to bug reports and timestamps, suitable for cross-origin message passing.

methods.name: constructor(readonly window: Window, readonly origin: string) {} constructor
methods.description: Initializes the CrossToolProtocol instance, setting up message event listener.

methods.name: setOnBugreportReceived
methods.description: Sets the callback to invoke upon receiving a bug report message.

methods.name: setOnTimestampReceived
methods.description: Sets the callback to invoke upon receiving a timestamp message.

methods.name: sendTimestamp
methods.description: Sends a timestamp message to the remote tool if connected.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming message events, validates origin, and dispatches based on message type.

methods.name: onMessageBugreportReceived
methods.description: Processes a bug report message and invokes the callback.

methods.name: onMessageTimestampReceived
methods.description: Processes a timestamp message and invokes the callback.
